thread:
Morgan: Heads-up — new org bootstrapping for client X. Need to request a few nonstandard quotas across AWS/GCP/Azure before we hand off to platform. TL;DR: GPUs (A100/4x), extra VPC internal IPs, extra external ephemeral IPs, and increased NICs.
Raj: Can you list exact targets per provider? helps speed the quota requests.
Morgan: Yep. Initial ask: GCP: 8x A100 40GB (us-central1) + 200 reserved internal IPs in project network + 50 ephemeral external IPs. AWS: 4x p4d per-account limit increase (us-east-1) + ENI limit bump to 2000. Azure: 6x ND A100 v4 in East US + increase public IP addresses for the subscription to 60.
Kai: For GCP internal IPs — do we need them at the VPC subnet level or at project-wide level? Also do we plan Shared VPC?
Morgan: Subnet level is the blocker. We'll be using Shared VPC from infra-project, so request should be against the host project. Include note: "for managed inference clusters (redwood-dedicated)".
Olivia: IAM checklist: create service account with roles: compute.networkAdmin, compute.viewer, iam.serviceAccountUser, and a dedicated quota monitor SA with logging permissions. Tagging policy: add labels: org=client-x, env=prod, team=platform. Put that in the ticket.
Ben: For GCP quota requests include the following JSON in the support form — paste exact numbers so support can pre-approve: ```{
  "project": "infra-host-client-x",
  "quotas": [
    {"metric": "NVIDIA A100 40GB GPUs", "limit": "8", "region": "us-central1"},
    {"metric": "In-use IP addresses (internal)", "limit": "200", "region": "global"},
    {"metric": "External IP addresses (ephemeral)", "limit": "50", "region": "global"}
  ]
}```
Raj: On AWS we should also request a soft limit for EBS throughput per account — inference nodes will need higher burst IO. Add: gp3 IOPS baseline bump to 20k for the commit.
Kai: One gotcha — some regions have stock constraints for p4d. We'll add fallback policy: if p4d not available, route to g5g or a family that we pre-approve. Add it to the ticket as a capacity preference list.
Morgan: Good point. I'll add priority list: p4d (primary) -> g5g -> p3dn. Also add request for spot/inference-savings quotas for Dedicated burst capacity.
quota-bot: Reminder: GCP quota tickets usually take 24-72 hours. Attach billing account ID and confirm billing enabled.
Olivia: Billing note: link infra-host-client-x to billing account BA-12345 and enable billing export to BigQuery (dataset: billing_client_x). Also enable billing alerts for spend > $5k/day.
Ben: Network note — request increased routes per VPC if we plan >50 clusters. On GCP the default cloud routers and route limits may bite us. Add: request 1000 routes.
Raj: I can open AWS limit requests (support console) once you drop the exact JSON. I’ll also pre-check region capacity with our partners.
Morgan: Dropping draft for tickets in #infra-docs, will ping when done. Thanks all — aim to file today so procurement can approve nodes by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Olivia: NIT: add ownership field on each ticket: "owner: infra-sre@redwood.com" and SLA requested: 48h.
Morgan: Will do.
